lq.q: Explain the different strategies for allocation of frames in memory management.
answer: Frame allocation refers to how the operating system distributes available physical memory frames among active processes .(20%)
The goal is to ensure fairness , minimize page faults , and optimize system performance .
Every process gets the same number of frames , regardless of size or need.
Every process gets the same number of frames , regardless of size or need.
Simple to implement.

❌ May lead to inefficiency for large processes and wastage for small ones.

If 100 frames are available and 5 processes → each gets 20 frames.
If 100 frames are available and 5 processes → each gets 20 frames.
Frames are allocated based on the size of the process.
Frames are allocated based on the size of the process.
A process with larger memory needs gets more frames .
